WITH hd_filtered AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, hd_vehicle_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE   (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000') 
        AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
), store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, COUNT(*) cnt 
    FROM store_sales JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        JOIN hd_filtered ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_filtered.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND date_dim.d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
      AND hd_filtered.hd_dep_count > hd_filtered.hd_vehicle_count
    GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
), customer_sales AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, 
           ss_ticket_number, cnt
    FROM store_sales_filtered JOIN customer ON store_sales_filtered.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT * 
FROM customer_sales
WHERE cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY cnt DESC, c_last_name ASC
